selection: Three independent public works per category (JPEG, audio, video), selected before measurement for documented reuse permission, content/duration/size variety and manageable downloads. Each category includes at least one original larger than the 1 MiB Fold chunk. Convenience sample, not representative of any media population. Original means the complete Commons upload, not necessarily a camera master. First three samples retain their 2026-10-01 retrieval date.
